findings.message: fixed in 4f5a170: a clean worktree was removed with its gitignored files (.env, local databases); non-regenerable ignored files now keep it in review
regenerable folders match on the last path component at any depth, so an ignored folder named build, out or target holding hand-made output counts as disposable
a session holding a clean worktree open for over 24 hours without committing is not detected; documented
fixed in 4f5a170: gitignored files were deleted with a clean worktree; tidy step order and failure wording in /ship and the skill corrected
the regenerable list (out, build, target) is not named in the README or ship.md
under pipefail a status over the pipe buffer can make grep -q read as no changes; git worktree remove still refuses a dirty worktree
fixed in 4f5a170: an unreadable age defaulted to 0 and read as idle; it is now review; unguarded git calls, locked-and-gone and branch-delete reporting also fixed
status output over about 64KB makes printf | grep -q return SIGPIPE under pipefail, so a dirty worktree is labelled safe; git worktree remove then refuses it and the run exits 1, no data lost
